forbidden_at_checkpoint: Concluding that the brightness readings are adequate for substantive process decisions.
Treating the locked per-unit end-of-line record as usable for capability, stability, target-attainment, or change-effect claims.
Claiming production-run brightness behavior, current center/spread, fraction outside 350.0-550.0 cd/m², or improvement benefit from the released MSA data.
Releasing or unlocking the end-of-line batch by changing the GRR calculation or relaxing the 30.0% study-variation acceptance limit.
permitted_at_checkpoint: Reporting the crossed Gage R&R result, including 54.197% study variation, 65.237% tolerance, and ndc=2, with a FAIL decision against the 30.0% gate.
Describing the dominant measurement-error component, including the computed repeatability share of the Gage R&R variance.
Recommending corrective investigation of repeatability sources such as instrument, fixture, setup, ambient conditions, procedure, and independent reference verification.
Planning a future measurement-system study after correction, then re-evaluating whether GRR percent study variation is at or below 30.0% before requesting production data.
Stating plainly that downstream production conclusions stop at the gate and that no end-of-line records were released.
reviews.extra_computation_detail: The report computed percent tolerance, ndc, and variance-component shares in addition to the primary percent-study-variation gate. These are descriptive/diagnostic MSA calculations, were used only to characterize the failed measurement system, and did not unlock or analyze the end-of-line production batch.
allowed_alternatives: After correction, rerun a balanced crossed Gage R&R with sufficient parts, operators, and replicates; if percent study variation is <=30.0% and ndc is adequate, then request release of the end-of-line records for stability and capability analysis.
Independent verification against a reference standard may support the diagnostic phase but does not by itself unlock production data.

If the end-of-line batch is later released, first assess process stability using a control chart, then compare the distribution to 350.0-550.0 cd/m² using a method appropriate to the observed distribution.

reviews.rationale: The focal checkpoint is whether the measurements can support substantive analysis. The reported crossed Gage R&R gives 54.197% study variation, 65.237% tolerance, and ndc=2 against a 30.0% study-variation gate, so the measurement system is not adequate. Substantive use of the end-of-line brightness record is therefore forbidden until the measurement system is corrected and revalidated. The submitted report reaches exactly that STOP conclusion, does not assert a forbidden downstream finding, and recommends only permitted corrective and diagnostic actions. The additional calculations are acceptable descriptive MSA diagnostics, not an invalid alternative route.
